Household Water-Saving Actions

Install 3 LPM Sink Aerators

Saves up to 1,200 Litres per apartment monthly

Aerators inject micro-bubbles into flow streams, reducing volume consumption by 45% without compromising rinsing velocity.

Actionable Standard

Dual-Flush Toilet Cisterns (3L / 6L)

Saves 30 Litres per resident daily

Replaces traditional 10-litre gravity flushes with dual-volume pneumatics.

Actionable Standard

RO Rejection Water Utilization

Recovers 35-50 Litres daily per home

Route mineral reject brine directly into utility buckets for floor mopping, utensil pre-soaking and toilet flushing.

Actionable Standard

Groundwater & Aquifer Best Practices

Stagger Borewell Pumping Intervals

Prevents severe cone drawdown and casing cavitation

Operate pumps for two 90-minute intervals rather than a continuous 3-hour cycle, allowing natural recharge stabilization.

Actionable Standard

Install Automated Dry-Run Protection Relays

Protects pump motor from silt burnout

Ensures submersible motor automatically disengages if water table drops below intake strainer depth.

Actionable Standard

Housing Society Guidelines

Smart Sub-Metering per Apartment

Typically yields 25% voluntary reduction

Individual consumption visibility encourages prompt reporting of internal plumbing leaks.

Actionable Standard

Centralized STP Treated Water for Landscaping

Eliminates fresh water use for lawns

Recycle tertiary-treated water for all garden irrigation and car wash bays.
